changelog:
Initial release of Vietnamese speech-to-text using Gipformer ASR.

- Supports speech recognition for Vietnamese audio using a 65M parameter Zipformer-RNNT model.
- Accepts audio in WAV, FLAC, OGG, MP3, and M4A formats; any duration.
- Handles VAD chunking, batching, and provides full transcript with chunk metadata.
- Server and CLI tools provided for both API and script-based transcription.
- Configurable for quantization, batch size, decoding method, and format support (ffmpeg required for M4A).
- Includes health check and comprehensive API documentation.
